description: Create a collection, or a sound board with kind "board". Limits are counted per kind: free accounts can have 1 collection and 1 sound board; Pro accounts can have up to 1,000 of each and can create 60 per hour. Set commercial false before adding CC BY-NC tracks; CC BY-NC tracks cannot go in a commercial collection.

commercial.description: Whether the collection is for commercial use. Defaults to true.

kind.description: collection (the default) or board, a collection the website plays as a grid of pads.

name: create_collection
title: Create a collection
